🔶 **Security** | Major

**HMAC compared with non-constant-time equality.** verifySignature checks `signature === expected`, which short-circuits at the first differing character. That leaks timing information about the expected HMAC on a public, unauthenticated endpoint. Compare with crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length Buffers, skipping candidates whose length differs because timingSafeEqual throws on unequal lengths. This needs a new import on line 1.

<sub>Test to extend: `test/webhooks.test.ts:30` — add the case this comment describes</sub>
